title: Automatic Detection of Focal Cortical Dysplasia Type II in MRI: Is the Application of Surface-Based Morphometry and Machine Learning Promising?
summary: The study reports diagnostic performance for focal cortical dysplasia type II in a defined epilepsy MRI dataset. Performance is specific to the studied MRI cohort and reference labels; generalization to other scanners and prospective workflows is not established.
ai_technology: Surface-based MRI morphometry and machine-learning classifiers were used to detect focal cortical dysplasia type II against clinical and surgical reference labels.
organization: Medical Physics Research Center, Mashhad University of Medical Sciences; Razavi Hospital
